assessor.role: Read-only static estate inventory and evidence gaps. No recommendations, fabricated metrics/estimates, mandatory build or execution.

classifier.role: Six-R comparison, feasibility/trade-offs and sourced cost assumptions. User selects; does not execute or author the selected plan.

planner.role: Selected-path plan, cross-repository dependencies, measurable phase criteria, integrated data/cutover/rollback plan and permissions. Does not authorize execution.

execution-orchestrator.role: Bounded authorized execution through qualified experts; dependency order, scope and evidence. Separate from Squad routing, review, validation and human authorization.

reviewer.role: Independent revision-bound artifact/diff quality verdict; neither implements reviewed work nor grants operational permission.

validator.role: Pre-implementation acceptance-design/testability/evidence-sufficiency consultation; later independently measured outcomes, characterization/data/cutover/rollback verification under separate authorization. Planned tests are not results; never self-certifies its own contribution or execution.

documentation.role: On-demand evidence-linked playbooks, technical writing, runbooks and diagrams. Phase owners retain technical decisions and phase accountability.

db-sqlserver.role: T-SQL, procedures, SQL Agent, CLR, collations, transactions, HA/DR and Azure SQL/managed variants.

db-postgresql.role: Extensions, PL/pgSQL, MVCC, indexing/partitioning, logical replication and Azure offering constraints.

db-oracle.role: PL/SQL, data types, optimizer, tablespaces, RAC/Data Guard, security and licensing constraints.

db-mysql.role: MySQL/MariaDB differences, storage engines, routines, replication and query semantics.

db-mongodb.role: BSON, document models, aggregation, indexing/sharding, change streams and compatibility limits.

db-cosmosdb.role: API selection, partition keys, RU/cost modeling, consistency, multi-region behavior and SDK contracts.

db-db2.role: Mainframe/distributed Db2 dialects, packages/host variables, utilities and replication; qualified operators required for actual operations.

db-cassandra.role: CQL, partition/clustering design, consistency, repair/compaction and compatible-target limitations.

db-dynamodb.role: Key/index design, single-table patterns, conditional writes, Streams/TTL and transition from an AWS source.

db-redis.role: Authoritative primary-store structures, persistence, transactions/Lua, clustering and Streams; cache-only concerns belong to Cache.

db-couchbase.role: Buckets/scopes/collections, KV/sub-documents, N1QL, indexing, eventing and XDCR.

db-sybase.role: SAP ASE dialect, procedures/tempdb, locking, replication and migration compatibility.

expert-auth-identity.role: LDAP/AD/Entra, OAuth/OIDC/SAML, federation, claims, user/service identity and authorization flows; not credential lifecycle ownership.

expert-hosting.role: IIS, Windows Services, Tomcat/JBoss/WebLogic, VMs, Docker/Kubernetes/AKS, topology and runtime lifecycle/coexistence. Consumes Azure platform guardrails; does not own pipelines or select targets by preference.

expert-cicd.role: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, artifact provenance, promotion, release gates and delivery/rollback automation. Does not own platform policy, runtime topology or grant provisioning/publication/cutover permission.

expert-secrets.role: Credential/certificate inventory without disclosure, rotation, secret lifecycle, managed identity integration and Key Vault; collaborates with Identity on trust boundaries.

expert-messaging.role: JMS/ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ/Kafka/MSMQ/SQS/Service Bus/Event Hubs, delivery/order/retry/idempotency and event contracts.

expert-storage.role: File/NAS/object/blob/S3, mounted volumes, retention, access and file semantics; not database engine behavior.

expert-cache.role: Redis/Memcached/NCache caching, invalidation, session state, eviction and cache transition; authoritative Redis data stays with `db-redis`.

expert-email.role: SMTP/service delivery, templates, authentication and deliverability; distinct message acceptance/delivery evidence.

expert-search.role: Solr/Lucene/Elasticsearch/Azure AI Search, analyzers, indexing/ranking/query contracts and rebuild/reconciliation.

expert-serverless.role: Functions/Lambda source contracts, event triggers, cold starts, state and scaling; Azure Platform/Hosting provide service and topology constraints.

expert-realtime.role: SignalR/WebSockets/SSE/long polling, connection state, reconnect, fan-out and client compatibility.

expert-reporting.role: Crystal/SSRS/Telerik rendering, extraction, layouts and report interactions; Scheduling owns job timing and desktop experts own application flows.

expert-scheduling.role: Hangfire/Quartz/Windows Scheduler/cron/durable jobs, calendars/timezones, retry/misfire and batch timing; not reporting semantics.

expert-frontend-legacy.role: jQuery/Knockout/AngularJS, DOM-driven UI, state and progressive/coexistence seams; modern framework experts own their respective implementations.

expert-struts.role: Actions/form beans/interceptors/validation, request flow and JSP integration.

expert-jsf.role: Facelets, component lifecycle, managed beans, navigation and server-side state.

expert-jsp-servlet.role: Servlet/filter lifecycle, JSP/taglibs, sessions and rendering contracts.

expert-jvm-builds.role: Ant/Maven/Gradle, wrappers, packaging/plugins and dependency/build graphs; not release pipeline ownership.

expert-platform-java.role: JVM generations, runtime compatibility, javax/jakarta and EE; conditional Spring/Quarkus/Micronaut platform questions. Does not absorb framework/build/ORM/testing experts.

expert-orm-java.role: Hibernate/JPA/JDBC/Spring Data/MyBatis mapping, generated queries and transaction behavior; consult engine owners.

expert-testing-java.role: JUnit/TestNG/Mockito/AssertJ, fixtures and characterization/integration test design; Validator independently judges outcomes.

expert-di-java.role: Spring/Guice/CDI/Dagger scopes, lifecycle and composition roots; separate from external configuration.

expert-config-java.role: XML/annotations/properties/Spring configuration, precedence, overlays and flags; separate from object lifetimes.

expert-security-java.role: Spring Security/JAAS/Shiro/filter/method security and framework enforcement; Identity owns cross-system identity contracts.

expert-logging-java.role: Log4j/SLF4J/Logback/JUL appenders, structured logs and implementation compatibility; Reliability owns cross-stack SLOs and acceptance.

expert-webforms.role: Page lifecycle, ViewState, controls/postbacks, session and code-behind.

expert-wcf.role: WCF bindings/behaviors/contracts, hosting/security and supported coexistence.

expert-asmx.role: SOAP/WSDL, XML serialization, handlers and service references.

expert-remoting.role: Channels/sinks, MarshalByRefObject, lifetimes and binary/distributed-object contracts.

expert-aspnet-mvc.role: Classic ASP.NET MVC/Razor/Areas/filters/model binding/routing; collaborates with ASP.NET Core/API rather than silently equating frameworks.

expert-winforms.role: Designer/events/bindings/threading, Windows/VB.NET desktop flows, printing, offline behavior and deployment/update.

expert-wpf.role: XAML/visual tree/MVVM/bindings/commands, Windows/VB.NET desktop flows, accessibility and OS integration.

expert-silverlight.role: Browser-hosted constraints/XAML/RIA services and client-service coupling; no assumed web rewrite.

expert-dotnet-builds.role: MSBuild/NuGet/project systems, packages.config, SDK-style transitions and compiler/build compatibility; CI/CD remains separate.

expert-platform-dotnet.role: .NET Framework and modern .NET, C#/VB.NET runtime/compiler compatibility and in-place upgrades; not a replacement for framework specialists.

expert-orm-dotnet.role: EF6/EF Core/NHibernate/Dapper/ADO.NET/LINQ to SQL mapping, query and transaction behavior; consult engine owners.

expert-testing-dotnet.role: MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/Moq/assertions/fixtures and characterization/integration tests; Validator retains independent outcome judgment.

expert-di-dotnet.role: Unity/Ninject/Autofac/built-in DI, service scopes/lifetimes and composition roots.

expert-config-dotnet.role: web.config/app.config/appsettings, transforms, Options, precedence and runtime overlays.

expert-logging-dotnet.role: NLog/Serilog/log4net/ILogger/OpenTelemetry sinks, structured logs and implementation continuity; Reliability owns cross-stack acceptance.

expert-serialization-dotnet.role: Binary/XML/Newtonsoft/System.Text.Json, stored payload/wire compatibility, defaults and converters; consult each service/framework owner.

expert-cobol.role: COBOL, copybooks, JCL, CICS, VSAM, batch/online transactions and mainframe integration. Remains a distinct accountable expert, not a .NET legacy-services skill; actual operations require qualified operators and authorization.

expert-classic-asp.role: Classic ASP/VBScript/includes/session/application state and IIS/COM dependencies; separate from ASP.NET.

expert-com-interop.role: Registration/interop assemblies/apartments/COM+/DCOM/binary contracts; collaborates with desktop, hosting and service experts.

expert-react.role: React/Next.js components, routing/rendering/data flows and progressive transitions.

expert-blazor.role: Blazor UI/render modes, component/interaction lifecycle and client/server contracts; consult .NET runtime experts.

expert-vue.role: Vue/Nuxt components, state, routing/rendering and compatibility.

expert-angular.role: Angular components/templates/DI, reactive flows, tooling and upgrade seams; distinct from AngularJS.

expert-svelte.role: Svelte/SvelteKit reactivity, rendering and client/server contracts.

expert-astro.role: Static/hybrid rendering, islands and integration boundaries.

expert-nodejs-typescript.role: Typed APIs, Node runtime/module/package/build and dependency compatibility.

expert-bun.role: Bun runtime/package/test/tooling differences and Node compatibility proof; kept distinct, not assumed interchangeable.

expert-go.role: Go services, module/build/runtime, goroutines/concurrency and interop constraints.

expert-rust.role: Rust services, ownership/async/build/FFI and native dependencies; distinct from Go.

expert-python.role: Broadened Python: FastAPI/Django/Flask, WSGI/ASGI, packaging/runtime, workers/batch and concurrency. Retains FastAPI expertise without mandating it.

expert-aspire.role: Aspire distributed-application modeling, orchestration, service integration and telemetry for **polyglot applications, not .NET-only applications**. Collaborates with each language/runtime expert; not automatic adoption or cloud authorization. Only aspire.dev and the official Aspire repository are authoritative.

expert-dapr.role: Sidecars/components, service invocation, state/pub-sub contracts, resilience and hosting integration; separate from Aspire orchestration and mandatory adoption.

expert-react-native.role: React Native device/platform interaction, native bridges, deployment and client/API contracts; distinct mobile expert, not a conditional web skill.

expert-flutter.role: Dart/Flutter device/web interactions, widgets/state, platform channels and backend contracts; distinct from React Native and web frameworks.

product-analyst.role: Engagement framing, stakeholder discovery, problem/outcomes, business requirements and integrated PRD. Human customer owns decisions/acceptance; Documentation assists presentation; Planner owns technical delivery plan.

security-privacy.role: Qualified security/privacy assurance, threat/control/data-privacy evidence and planning risk. Distinct from Identity, Secrets and Rai; customer legal/compliance obligations and waivers require authorized human owners, never invented certification.

expert-aspnet-core-api.role: Modern ASP.NET Core/API endpoints, middleware, routing, binding, hosting integration and API compatibility. Distinct from classic ASP.NET MVC and general .NET runtime knowledge.

azure-platform.role: Azure landing zones, subscription/management boundaries, policy, governance, region/service fit, network/DNS, quotas, resource organization and pricing/sizing assumptions. Not Hosting's application topology or CI/CD's delivery automation.

reliability.role: Cross-stack reliability, performance, observability, load/capacity, availability/recovery, SLOs and measurement methods. Language-specific logging experts own implementation; Validator independently verifies outcomes.

accessibility-ux.role: Web, desktop and mobile accessibility/UX assurance: keyboard/focus, assistive technology, interaction flows and regression criteria. Framework/client experts implement changes; does not duplicate their ownership.

data-transition.role: Cross-engine reconciliation, authoritative write ownership, CDC/backfill, rehearsal, cutover and rollback/reverse-data assurance. Planner owns plan integration; DB/application experts supply semantics; Validator independently verifies.
